subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as `append?: boolean` on `write`, switch to a `mode` field, or use a separate append tool before this PR lands?
rationale: The bug and need are well supported, but the permanent model-facing write contract is a maintainer-owned product/API choice.

options.title: Accept append boolean after summary fix
options.body: Keep this PR's additive `append?: boolean` shape once the prompt, catalog, and UI summaries advertise it consistently.

options.title: Switch to mode
options.body: Ask the branch to replace the boolean with an explicit mode field if maintainers want a more extensible write contract.

options.title: Use separate append tool
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want overwrite and append to stay as separate tool operations.

recommendation.title: Accept append boolean after summary fix
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's additive `append?: boolean` shape once the prompt, catalog, and UI summaries advertise it consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history signal for agent runtime and tool API direction among the likely owners.
